extraction_query: Extract business data entities the application handles. A data entity is a business object or record type — not a database table name alone. For each entity state its purpose, important fields and business use, sources, sinks, lifecycle stages from creation to deletion, and owning store when known. key_fields must list business-significant attributes, not a short identity subset: include related-party or guardian-style fields, policy flags, location or channel flags, and configuration knobs that staff can see or that other logic reads. Do not truncate key_fields for length. Configuration entities must include every policy setting found on that record. If a setting is stored or displayed but never applied at runtime, still list it in key_fields and say in the statement that it is not applied at runtime.
